Issue: #5974

render the displayName for the component name if a forwardRef element
provides it.

## What I did

* Added branching logic to `Node` component's check for `forwardRef` to render original component `displayName` if present.
* Add new example for `forwardRef` component in kitchen sink app with `forwardRef` element with a `displayName`

## How to test

- Is this testable with Jest or Chromatic screenshots? Yes
- Does this need a new example in the kitchen sink apps? Yes
- Does this need an update to the documentation? Maybe, to explain why things change

body: This is being caused by PR https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/pull/4961 and I'm hoping I have a proposed solution up at the moment.
@elie222 I'm assuming yes, the original reason I started investigating this was due to inconsistencies between v4 and v5 using styled-components.

Yippee!! I just released https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/releases/tag/v5.1.0-alpha.19 containing PR #6222 that references this issue. Upgrade today to try it out!
